body: Published a data-driven Mid-Piano episode built on real per-hero win/loss reconstructed from REDGARDEN's var/matches/*.jsonl logs for the last 24h (416 files, 199 complete matches). Cross-checked against IDUNA's cumulative hero-leaderboard endpoint -- numbers matched exactly, confirming this is genuinely the full dataset so far, not a slice. Findings: Tyler/Ada lead ~59%, Duck last at 42.8%/28, all 8 newest heroes cluster in the bottom 10 (Gunnr flagged in-episode as a mid-window old-kit/new-kit blend since his Consecration rework landed today). Live at okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-scoreboard/. Commit 9dde74d.
title: Blog: Mid-Piano Presents: The Scoreboard (real 24h hero data)
